briefing: Markets were flat today with NASDAQ and S&P 500 both down just 0.1%, showing no clear directional signal. Cash on hand is only $89.29, well below the $500 threshold needed to open a new position, so no buys were made. Existing positions were left untouched since the market gave no reason to exit strong holds on a neutral day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Sometimes the best move is no move at all — with only $89.29 in cash, there simply wasn't enough capital to open a meaningful new position, even though 3 portfolio slots were open. Holding cash and waiting for a stronger setup (or more capital) avoids forcing a low-quality trade just to stay busy.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 有時候最好的操作就是按兵不動——目前現金僅有89.29美元，即使還有3個投資組合空位，也沒有足夠資金開立有意義的新倉位。持有現金並等待更佳時機（或更多資金），比為了「有動作」而勉強交易更為明智。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ and S&P 500 each dipping about 0.1%. There was no dominant catalyst driving the session, reflecting a market pausing to digest recent moves rather than reacting to fresh news. Low-volatility, directionless days like this are common between earnings cycles or major macro data releases.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現大致持平，納斯達克及標普500指數均僅微跌約0.1%。市場缺乏明顯的主導因素，反映投資者在消化近期走勢，而非對重大新聞作出反應。這種低波動、方向不明的交易日在業績公佈期或重要宏觀數據公佈之間頗為常見。
